author: atomlabor
description: Your Home Assistant on e-ink: a hero card with your key values, lights and switches as tiles you tap to toggle, what is playing on Spotify with cover and controls, all sensors at a glance, refreshed live every 30 seconds while the app is open. Set it up right on the device: sign in with your Home Assistant user name (only a sign-in key is kept, never the password), paste a token or drop a homeassistant.txt into the app folder. Arrange the tiles in your own order, the first three sensors fill the big card. An optional PIN lock keeps others from switching your home. The lock screen shows a large clock, up to six values you choose what is playing and the lights that are on; while locked it fetches new values as often as you choose, from every minute to once an hour (5 minutes by default).
